confirm.emptyBody: Every item and file in the trash is deleted for good, with the history of the items. This cannot be undone.
confirm.purgeFileBody: The file is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
confirm.purgeFilesBody_one: The selected file is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
confirm.purgeFilesBody_other: The {{count}} selected files are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
confirm.purgeItemBody: The item and its history are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
confirm.purgeItemBodyFiles_one: The item, its history and the file that went to the trash with it are deleted for good. A file another item still uses is kept. This cannot be undone.
confirm.purgeItemBodyFiles_other: The item, its history and the {{count}} files that went to the trash with it are deleted for good. A file another item still uses is kept. This cannot be undone.
confirm.purgeItemsBody_one: The selected item, its history and its files are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
confirm.purgeItemsBody_other: The {{count}} selected items, their history and their files are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

empty.body: Deleted items and files wait here until they are restored or deleted for good.
empty.title: The trash is empty

subtitle_one: Deleted items and files stay here for {{count}} day. After that they are deleted for good.
subtitle_other: Deleted items and files stay here for {{count}} days. After that they are deleted for good.
subtitleNoRetention: Deleted items and files stay here for a while. After that they are deleted for good.
title: Trash

toast.emptied_one: Trash emptied. {{count}} entry deleted for good.
toast.emptied_other: Trash emptied. {{count}} entries deleted for good.
toast.itemRestoredUnassignedBody: Its area was deleted while the item was in the trash. Open the item to file it somewhere.
toast.itemsRestoredUnassigned_one: {{count}} of them came back without a location because its area was deleted.
toast.itemsRestoredUnassigned_other: {{count}} of them came back without a location because their areas were deleted.
toast.restoreUnknown_one: No answer came back for {{count}} item, so it may have been restored. Check the list.
toast.restoreUnknown_other: No answer came back for {{count}} items, so they may have been restored. Check the list.
